note: .text includes the Arduino core, TinyUSB and the Adafruit libraries; .heap (rest of RAM) is available to malloc; stack_dummy = core-0 stack reserve; flash_bytes = boot2 + ota + partition + text + rodata + data image
ram_accounting: RAM sections (.data, .bss, .uninitialized_data, .ram_vector_table, .heap, two 2 KB stacks) do not add up to 270,336 B: the 8 KB SCRATCH_X/Y banks hold only the two 2 KB stack reserves (4,096 B unused), and the rest of the gap is section alignment padding.
